updateLicence.doc: Verify and apply a new Drumee platform licence. Validates the provided licence content against a cryptographic signature using the Drumee public key at /etc/drumee/publickeys/drumee.com.pem. If verification succeeds, persists both licence_content and licence_signature to the system configuration via stored procedure sys_conf_set and reloads the server cache. Always returns the verification result regardless of success or failure.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature of the licence content, issued by Drumee. Used to verify authenticity against the Drumee public key.

content.description: Licence content payload to verify and store. Must match the provided signature to be accepted.

returns.description: Result object indicating whether the licence signature was successfully verified

verified.description: True if the signature was verified against the Drumee public key and the licence was applied. False if verification failed or an error occurred during processing.

errors.message: Drumee public key file not found at /etc/drumee/publickeys/drumee.com.pem
Signature verification failed or an internal error occurred. Response will contain verified: false.
